info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: The Cross-Channel Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and update cross-channel banking services using specific parameters. Primarily targeting financial institutions, this API provides the capability to adjust settings or values associated with point-of-service channels. By using the provided parameter, users can implement necessary changes to enhance customer service and streamline operations. Typical consumers include developers integrating banking functionalities within applications, ensuring that their services remain adaptable and user-focused.

patch.summary: Update a specific point of service in the cross-channel framework.
patch.description: This endpoint allows developers to make updates to a specific point of service identified by RES-100045 within the cross-channel platform. Ensure that all necessary fields are included in the request to perform a successful update.
